SIDDHARTH PENDHARKAR TRADE CONFIRMATION & SETTLEMENT | CAPITAL MARKETS OPERATIONS

Thane, Maharashtra | +91 9082417856 | pendharkarsiddharth2605@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Capital Markets and Investment Operations professional with extensive experience across Trade Confirmation, Trade Settlement, Trade Lifecycle Management, Reconciliation and Custody Operations. Hands-on experience across Equity and Fixed Income products, CTM, SWIFT settlement messaging (MT54x, MT103, MT202), trade matching and affirmation, SSI/static data, cash and position reconciliation, exception management and settlement-fail resolution. Experienced in stakeholder management, team leadership, SLA delivery, operational controls and client service.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Trade Lifecycle Management

Equity & Fixed Income

Trade Confirmation & Settlement

CTM / Trade Matching & Affirmation

SWIFT: MT54x / MT103 / MT202

Cash & Position Reconciliation

SSI / Static Data

Failed Trade & Exception Management

Custody Operations

Client & Stakeholder Management

Team Leadership / Training

MIS / KPI Reporting

Operational Risk & Controls

MS Excel / Power Query

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

GENPACT PVT LTD Assistant Manager – Trade Confirmation & Settlement | Pune | Jun 2025 – May 2026

Managed end-to-end trade confirmation and settlement for Equity and Fixed Income products, including trade matching,

affirmation and settlement processing.

Ensured timely trade affirmation through CTM, PDF confirmations, fax and email, validating price, quantity, currency, settlement

date and counterparty details.

Handled SWIFT settlement messages including MT54x, MT103 and MT202 for trade settlement and payment-related activities.

Validated and processed settlement instructions through CTM and SWIFT, ensuring trades were instructed within applicable market

cut-off times.

Monitored settlement status and investigated unmatched, failed and pending trades, coordinating with brokers, custodians and

internal trading desks for timely resolution.

Managed daily cash and position reconciliation breaks, investigating discrepancies across trade, settlement and accounting

records.

Supervised daily settlement activities across domestic and international markets, ensuring adherence to SLAs, controls and

operational risk requirements.

Acted as the primary escalation point for complex trade confirmation, settlement and reconciliation issues, driving timely

resolution.

Supported client onboarding and static data setup activities and coordinated with relevant teams for accurate implementation.

Performed quality checks across trade confirmation, settlement and reconciliation activities to minimize trade failures and

operational exceptions.

Conducted daily team huddles, work allocation and performance monitoring while supporting team productivity and delivery.

Prepared MIS reports and exception dashboards for management review and operational monitoring. ECLERX SERVICES LTD Process Manager – Security Transaction Settlement, Cash & Stock Reconciliation | Navi Mumbai | Aug 2022 – May 2025

Successfully migrated the security transaction process from the client’s Bangalore office to the Navi Mumbai delivery center.

Coordinated daily security and cash settlement activities across EMEA, DTC and APAC markets and with various financial

institutions.

Worked with traders and brokers on CTM confirmations, unmatched trades and failed trades for Equity and Fixed Income

transactions, escalating issues to avoid settlement failures.

Processed, monitored and approved manual static data setup based on client information and business requirements.

Siddharth Pendharkar | Capital Markets Operations

• Coordinated with agents and brokers on escalated securities transfer-in and transfer-out issues and monitored availability of client

holdings.

Performed daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation of Equity and Fixed Income execution products and resolved outstanding

breaks.

Maintained Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) in reference data and supported daily workflow and new-business activities.

Identified trade capture issues with potential risk/P&L impact and escalated them to relevant stakeholders.

Provided subject-matter expertise, trained new hires and supported cross-training across clients and processes.

Prepared KPI reporting for senior management and participated in client governance calls. STATE STREET SYNTEL SERVICES PVT LTD Team Leader – Trade Confirmation & Settlement Operations | Navi Mumbai | Jan 2011 – Jul 2022

Supported migration of Trade Confirmation and Settlement operations from the State Street London office to Navi Mumbai.

Produced reports and controls to monitor accuracy and compliance of client Fixed Income and Equity trade workflows.

Actively chased unmatched trades at CTM confirmation level, contract notes, acknowledgements and static-data requests.

Reviewed, investigated and cleared daily stock and cash reconciliation breaks.

Planned and scheduled team workload, monitored workflow and supported weekly/monthly progress reporting.

Mentored and cross-trained team members across different clients and processes.

Participated in workflow and exception reviews, escalating issues that could impact settlement SLAs, client service or financial risk.

Associate – Stock & Cash Reconciliation | Pune | May 2009 – Dec 2010

Investigated and resolved discrepancies between fund accounting books and custodian cash and securities accounts.

Performed account reconciliation activities in line with prescribed client standards.

Identified process gaps and proposed improvement opportunities.

Provided fund opening and closing cash availability information to clients. SYNTEL GLOBAL PVT LTD Associate – Life Insurance Process | Thane | Oct 2007 – Apr 2009

Handled life insurance policy contract creation, documentation quality checks and exception cases.

Maintained accurate client communication and policy records. UTI TECHNOLOGY SERVICES LTD Executive – Mutual Fund Processing | Mumbai | Jan 2006 – Sep 2007

Processed mutual fund sales and repurchase applications and performed CMS batch reconciliation for Axis and HDFC Bank.

Handled investor servicing activities including address changes, cheque revalidation, payment-mode changes and PAN objection

cases.

Resolved investor queries and prepared branch-level reporting.

EDUCATION

B.Com | S.K. Somaiya College of Arts, Science & Commerce, Vidyavihar, Mumbai | 2005 | 53.28%

TECHNOLOGY & TOOLS

CTM | Trade Settlement Platforms | SWIFT | Reconciliation Tools | SSI / Static Data | MS Excel | Power Query | MS Office

Siddharth Pendharkar | Capital Markets Operations
